frequency_question: How often do jurisdictions with a 0% active countercyclical capital buffer raise it above 0% within any given 2-year window?
membership_rule: Includes G20 central banks or monetary/regulatory authorities possessing the mandate to set a CCyB, observed over rolling 2-year periods between 2016 and 2026.

skeleton: Jurisdictions maintaining a permanent 0% setting versus those initiating active buffer deployment cycles during economic expansions.
multiplier: 4 active deployment events out of approximately 40 observed 2-year country windows where the starting buffer was 0%.
validity_reason: Basel III framework rules and institutional inertia for the Federal Reserve remain stable over this horizon.
